observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of the needle and presser foot area of a black sewing machine head mounted on a bright orange base.
Photo 1 shows the same head from a slightly different angle, with the 'TWO LION' logo visible on the black plate.
Photo 2 shows the full front view of the machine head, which is black with gold lettering and decorative patterns.
The machine head appears to be a manual treadle or foot pedal model.
The orange base has metal latches and appears to be a trunk or case.
The machine is not shown in operation; no power cord, foot pedal, or treadle is visible.
The seller claims it is 'ONLY HEAD' and 'neatly used'.

claims.claim: Neatly used Two Lion black head sewing machine available for sale in Ibadan.
claims.evidence: The brand 'TWO LION' is visible in photos 0 and 1, but 'neatly used' and 'available for sale in Ibadan' cannot be verified from photos alone.
The seller lists 'Comes with...' but no items are shown in the photos. No accessories or additional parts are visible.
